task: We want to send transactional mail from notify.orbitcart.io. Register that subdomain for outbound sending on our orbitcart.io zone, then show me the DNS records it requires so I can confirm they're in place.
Query our `user-activity-db` database to count how many records exist in the `event_logs` table where `status` is equal to 'failed', and report the count.
Create an object storage bucket named media-archive located in Western Europe, and set it up so anything under the tmp/ prefix is automatically deleted 30 days after upload.
Deploy a container workload named 'payment-processor' using the image 'registry.internal/finance/processor:v2.0' with 3 running instances and the environment variable 'LOG_LEVEL=info'.
Make mail sent to support@acme-widgets.com forward to our shared inbox helpdesk.acme@gmail.com, and have anything sent to any other address on that domain get dropped instead of bouncing.
Create a new message queue named `billing-events-queue` in our account to handle background processing. Configure it with a delivery delay of 30 seconds.
Set up a new IPFS gateway under the domain `dapp-storage.com` using the hostname `ipfs.dapp-storage.com` and set its description to 'Production IPFS Node'.

Our ad measurement is being hit by blockers, so set up acme-outdoors.com to load our Google Tag Manager container GTM-KX4P92T first-party from the path /gt-metrics on our own domain instead of from Google's domains. Also make sure visitors' original IP addresses are hidden.

For our zone shopnorth.com, switch the page visitors see when they get rate limited to our branded one hosted at https://assets.shopnorth.com/errors/rate-limited.html. Then tell me which of the other error and challenge pages on that zone are still using the stock default.

On our zone shopwave.io, check which endpoints have been auto-discovered on api.shopwave.io but aren't yet in our saved endpoint inventory, and add POST /v2/orders and GET /v2/customers/{id} to it. Then set those two so that requests not matching our uploaded OpenAPI schema get blocked rather than just logged.
Update the name of account `a1b2c3d4e5f67890123456789abcdef0` to 'Enterprise Core Services' and verify whether two-factor authentication enforcement is currently enabled on it.
The latest production release of our static site project "acme-landing" broke the checkout page. Find the last successful production deployment before it and roll the site back to that one.

Set up a new proxy endpoint called "support-bot-prod" for our LLM provider traffic. It should cache identical prompt responses for one hour, cap requests at 200 per minute, and keep request logs turned on.
Create a new private connection named `internal-app-link` in our account and set up its configuration so traffic for `internal.example.com` routes to `http://localhost:8000`.

On shopfront.io we have some legacy URL-pattern overrides. Find the one matching *shopfront.io/admin/* that sets cache level to "cache everything" and disable it without deleting it, then tell me which other ones are still active and in what priority order.

On our zone fleetwise.io, turn on gRPC and WebSocket proxying to the origin and enable HTTP/3 with 0-RTT connection resumption. Also check whether IPv6 compatibility is currently on and tell me what the max upload size is set to.

We're locking down the firewall on our origin servers so they only accept traffic that comes through the proxy. Get me the current list of IPv4 and IPv6 CIDR ranges your edge network connects from, including the ranges for the China partner network.

Restrict TLS termination and request processing for api.medirecord.eu to data centers inside the European Union. Also list the other hostnames in that zone that already have a geographic processing restriction, and which region each is pinned to.

Our branch-office WAN appliance (device ID 3f9a1c2e-58b4-4d7a-9e61-0c2b7a4d1f90) kept dropping offline yesterday. Pull everything it reported about its own state between 14:00 and 18:00 UTC and tell me whether it rebooted or tried a software upgrade in that window.

Put our game server at 203.0.113.45 on TCP port 25565 behind the edge proxy so players connect through mc.pixelforge-games.com instead of hitting the origin IP directly. Turn on PROXY protocol v1 so the server still sees real client addresses.
